scripts.build:electron: rm -rf build/electron && mkdir -p build/electron && bun build --target=node --format=esm --external electron ./src/electron/main.ts --outfile build/electron/main.mjs && bun build --target=node --format=cjs --external electron ./src/electron/preload.ts --outfile build/electron/preload.cjs && install -m 0644 ./src/electron/package.json ./build/electron/package.json
scripts.build: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && bun run build:electron && vite build
scripts.test: bun test src/lib dev && vitest run
